title: Diagnosing and Debiasing Corpus-Based Political Bias and Insults in GPT2

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's self-diagnosis capability and self-debiasing text generation by comparing its internal probabilities and generated continuations against scores from the Bipartisan Press Political Bias API.
Evaluating the model's self-diagnosis capability and self-debiasing text generation by comparing its internal probabilities and generated continuations against insult scores from the Perspective API.
Measuring the model's self-diagnosis accuracy and the reduction of toxic outputs after applying a self-debiasing algorithm, using toxicity and severe toxicity scores from the Perspective API.
Measuring the model's self-diagnosis accuracy and the reduction of biased outputs after applying a self-debiasing algorithm, using identity attack scores from the Perspective API.
Measuring the model's self-diagnosis accuracy and the reduction of biased outputs after applying a self-debiasing algorithm, using profanity scores from the Perspective API.
Measuring the model's self-diagnosis accuracy and the reduction of biased outputs after applying a self-debiasing algorithm, using threat scores from the Perspective API.
Measuring the model's self-diagnosis accuracy and the reduction of biased outputs after applying a self-debiasing algorithm, using sexually explicit scores from the Perspective API.
